name: Section Note (scrutiny)
summary: Applicant, licensing authority and committee details cross-checked; survey / revenue details; plan documents (P/O: 7 plans + signed by); fees due vs challan paid (+ challan slip OK); P only: 15 % bank guarantee and FFE estimate; deficiencies; submitter.

name: Inspection Report (Committee Chairman)
summary: Per block: discrepancies in the declared data; open spaces required vs proposed/provided with OK (Y/N) + remarks; means of escape (internal, external, total) OK + remarks; floors OK + remarks; fire fighting equipment OK + remarks; floor-wise FFE grid + comments; O: images remarks, PNOC conditions complied; R: documents remarks, specific conditions. Any other action; recommendation computed automatically (all observations OK → Recommend); remarks; inspection date.

name: Committee Member Concurrence
summary: After the chairman's report: 'I agree with the report submitted by the Chairman of the Inspection Committee' (Yes/No) + remarks.

name: RFO Note
summary: Per block: 1 occupancy, area, height; 2 NBC guidelines: open spaces required vs proposed + deficiency, staircases required vs proposed + deficiency, occupant load remarks, FFE required + deficiency (12 systems), other FFE; 3 approach road width per side (required / deficiency); 4 parking required vs proposed; 5 other applicable acts/rules; 6 points for the DGFS; 7 specific conditions complied; 8 recommendation (Recommend / Not recommend) + remarks. R variant: NBC rules, other action, other rules, points, agree with chairman's report, opinion.

name: Final Decision (Issuing Authority)
summary: Decision (Approved / Returned with Remarks / Rejected / Inspection — Declarations only); remarks for the applicant (bulleted, printed on the NOC / letter); remarks about the committee report; additional 'Copy to'; Renewal: valid from / valid to; preview of the NOC or letter; upload of the signed scanned document (required to submit).

questions.label: 1) Relevant applicable rules in the NBC guidelines
